$comment: MyTeam special cards (特殊卡). Put the picture in client/public/cards/ and name it in image (any size: the card crops it); without one the card uses the player's photo or drawn portrait. player = a current or history player to build on; someone new also needs position, heightM, number and style (shooter|slasher|playmaker|rim|allround), and may set look. ovr picks the tier (97-99 black). theme = one of themes: the frame, and the week the limited pack sells it (or the 活動關卡 holiday that names it); a levelOnly theme is never in a pack, its cards come from special levels only. label = the card's line (default: the theme's name).
